scenario: r1 has local addresses 192.0.2.10, .20, .30 and diagnostic .254 on lo0.0. A loopback input filter discards ICMP to some of them.

commonMistakes.mistake: Removing the whole filter or the deny term
commonMistakes.recognise: All three addresses answer after stage one
commonMistakes.symptom: 192.0.2.30 can no longer be denied in stage two

doneWhen: Three of three probes to 192.0.2.10 get replies.
explanation: The deny term matched ICMP to .10; removing .10 from its match lets the later accept term pass it.
stages.goal: Make 192.0.2.10 answer probes from r1 again.
stages.hint: Read which term matches ICMP to .10 and what it does.

r1: delete firewall family inet filter lo0-icmp term deny-icmp from destination-address 192.0.2.10/32

stages.title: Restore the first service

commonMistakes.mistake: Placing a discard term after the accept term

doneWhen: Three of three probes to 192.0.2.20 get replies.
Zero of three probes to 192.0.2.30 get replies.
explanation: The deny term must precede the accept-all term and match only ICMP to .30.
stages.goal: Allow 192.0.2.20 and deny 192.0.2.30 while keeping .10 reachable.
stages.hint: Terms are evaluated in order; first match wins.

r1: delete firewall family inet filter lo0-icmp term deny-icmp from destination-address 192.0.2.20/32
set firewall family inet filter lo0-icmp term deny-icmp from destination-address 192.0.2.30/32

stages.title: Complete the service access policy

r1: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 198.51.100.1/30
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 198.51.100.5/30
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet filter input lo0-icmp
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 192.0.2.254/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 192.0.2.10/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 192.0.2.20/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 192.0.2.30/32
set firewall family inet filter lo0-icmp term deny-icmp from destination-address 192.0.2.10/32
set firewall family inet filter lo0-icmp term deny-icmp from destination-address 192.0.2.20/32
set firewall family inet filter lo0-icmp term deny-icmp from protocol icmp
set firewall family inet filter lo0-icmp term deny-icmp then discard
set firewall family inet filter lo0-icmp term allow-rest then accept

startState.description: lo0.0 holds four /32 addresses; ge-0/0/0 and ge-0/0/1 are wired together and up. Filter lo0-icmp is applied inbound on lo0.0: ICMP to .10 and .20 is discarded, everything else accepted.

summary: Fix a loopback ICMP filter so two local services answer and one is denied.
title: Selective ICMP Access to Local Router Endpoints

nodes.role: Local ICMP access controlled by a loopback filter
